entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: A powerful Sorceress Queen of Rabiah who sought to force the Unification of Taysir and absorb his power.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: A plane existing in one thousand and one copies.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: A man existing in five versions, one per type of magic, who would become a planeswalker if united.

entities.name: El-Hajjâj
entities.description: Nailah's father and teacher, whom she overthrew and later killed.

entities.name: Raghib
entities.description: Fellow student of El-Hajjâj, seduced and cursed with leprosy by Nailah, later servant of the white Taysir.

entities.name: Ring of Ma'rûf
entities.description: A ring that allows locating the Taysirs.

entities.name: Lore of the Ancients
entities.description: A Rabian legend that spoke of the One Made of Five.

events.summary: Nailah, trained by her father El-Hajjâj alongside Raghib, overthrew and killed him.
events.quote: She later overthrew and killed her father.

events.summary: Nailah cursed Raghib with leprosy once he had found the Ring of Ma'rûf.
events.quote: Nailah had no further use for Raghib and cursed him with leprosy.

events.summary: Nailah learned the prophecy and found the five versions of Taysir.
events.quote: Nailah learned of this prophecy and found the five versions

events.summary: Nailah seduced the black Taysir and convinced him to kill and absorb the green one.
events.quote: Nailah seduced the black version of Taysir and convinced him to kill and absorb the green one.

events.summary: Taysir united his counterparts and defeated Nailah; in the battle she killed Raghib and El-Hajjâj.
events.quote: He eventually returned for the remaining parts, defeated Nailah, and merged with his final counterpart.

events.summary: Taysir became a planeswalker, struck Nailah with an energy blast and left; Nailah barred his return with a barrier.
events.quote: Nailah created a barrier around the Rabiahs, preventing him from ever returning.

relations.quote: She later overthrew and killed her father.
